title: Roots Beside the River
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A psalm was written long ago
about a tree so small,
Beside a river, cool and clear,
the happiest of all.

[Chorus]
Each day when you hear God's good words,
you're like that little tree;
Your roots grow deep, your heart grows strong,
and kind as you can be.

[Verse 2]
It drank the water, day by day,
its roots grew deep and strong;
Its leaves stayed green, its fruit grew sweet
and good the whole year long.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little tree,
and rest beside the stream;
God's near, and His good words will grow
inside you while you dream.

[Chorus]
mood: Flowing music. A soft, rippling sway moves under the voice, like river water passing steadily beside a little tree's roots. The first two verses keep that easy, flowing pulse as the tree drinks and grows. By the last verse the ripple slows and settles lower, the water barely moving, the roots resting deep in the ground.
